definitions.meaning: a waterway of the Middle East flowing into the Dead Sea
the professional name of the British glamour model Katie Price

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are proper names: a Middle Eastern waterway and a well-known British glamour model's stage name.

clue.text: Out east, boy eats bitter pastries

indicators.note: eats means the trimmed name swallows the next piece inside it
out tells us the letter for east is put out of the boy's name

parts.note: James is a boy's name
E is the compass abbreviation for east
tart means sharp or bitter in taste

explanation.surface: A boy abroad in the east bites into some sour pastries.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Out' removes E from JAMES to leave JAMS, and 'eats' puts TART inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: These are small pastry cases filled with fruit preserve, a type of pastry.

clue.text: Reinvigorating medicine providing repose to labourer without exercise

parts.note: repose means rest

indicators.note: without signals that the letters for exercise are taken away from the worker

parts.note: an operative is a factory worker or labourer
PE is physical education, exercise at school

explanation.surface: A tonic that lets a worker rest without doing any exercise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' takes PE out of OPERATIVE to leave ORATIVE, placed after REST.
explanation.definitionFit: A tonic that restores strength is a reinvigorating remedy.

indicators.note: removing top of means the first letter of the piece of furniture is dropped

parts.note: a table is a piece of furniture

explanation.surface: Someone skilled at stripping the top off a piece of furniture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'removing top of' drops the T from TABLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Proficient means competent or skilled, a synonym.

clue.text: River poet exchanging man for woman

indicators.note: exchanging ... for says one letter is swapped out and another put in its place

parts.note: Walter de la Mare was an English poet
M is short for man or male

explanation.surface: A poet who swaps a man for a woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exchanging' replaces the M (man) in DE LA MARE with W (woman).
explanation.definitionFit: A US river flowing into Delaware Bay, which shares its name with the state.

clue.text: Atones for abstract art taken from citizens living abroad

indicators.note: abstract read as a verb means drawn off, so the letters of art are extracted in any order
taken from says the letters of art come out of the people living abroad

parts.note: expatriates are citizens living outside their homeland

explanation.surface: Making amends for abstract art pinched from people overseas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abstract ... taken from' removes the letters A, T and R (art jumbled) from EXPATRIATES, leaving the answer in order.
explanation.definitionFit: To expiate is to make amends for a sin or wrong, which is to atone.

clue.text: When scar forms with murderous intentions

definitions.meaning: a scar appears once bleeding has stopped, so the phrase reads as following the bleeding
someone seeking to kill is said to be out for or ...

explanation.definitionFit: One phrase read two ways: following bleeding in time, and hunting for bloodshed as a killer would.

parts.note: RM is a Royal Marine, a seagoing serviceman

explanation.surface: A seaman's weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: Arms are weapons, so an arm is a single weapon.

indicators.note: it's said tells us the phrase is heard rather than read

parts.note: ex means former and a seed is a favourite in a tennis draw

explanation.surface: Beating the one-time favourite, so people say.
explanation.walkthrough: A seed is a ranked player in a knockout tournament, a favourite; EX plus SEED sounds like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To exceed is to go beyond, a synonym of surpass.

parts.note: Lent is the Christian period of fasting
love is zero in tennis, shaped like O

explanation.surface: Something that is both slow and quick, my love.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fast' looks like the opposite of the definition but is a noun: a period of abstinence.
explanation.definitionFit: A musical direction meaning play slowly.

indicators.note: in places the measure inside the jumbled letters

parts.note: an ell is an old measure of cloth length

clue.text: River too turbulent in settlement ebbing

ebbing means flowing back, so the settlement word reads backwards

parts.note: a camp is a temporary settlement

indicators.note: turbulent means disordered, so the letters of too are mixed

explanation.surface: A river turns too turbulent as it ebbs past a settlement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ebbing' turns CAMP into PMAC; 'turbulent' rearranges TOO as OTO, which 'in' places inside.
explanation.definitionFit: The waterway that flows past Washington DC into Chesapeake Bay.

clue.text: River — river in Newcastle in spate

indicators.note: the first in puts the letter for river inside the scrambled city
a river in spate is in flood and churned up, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: R is the map abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: A river flooding through Newcastle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in spate' rearranges NEWCASTLE and the first 'in' puts R inside. Newcastle is a city in north-east England.
explanation.definitionFit: A North American waterway draining the Great Lakes into the Atlantic.

clue.text: Unconcern for no new opportunity accepting a learner

indicators.note: accepting means the opportunity takes the other letters inside it

parts.note: a chance is an opportunity
L is a learner driver, from the L-plate

explanation.surface: Indifference because a new opportunity went to a beginner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'accepting' puts A and L inside CHANCE to make CHALANCE after NO and N.
explanation.definitionFit: Nonchalance is a calm, casual indifference, a synonym.

clue.text: US police vans or butchers' trucks

definitions.meaning: American slang for police vans or ambulances

explanation.definitionFit: American slang for a police van, and literally carts carrying meat for a butcher.

indicators.note: involving means the reversed word wraps round the actor

parts.note: the word is read as set back, that is set reversed, giving TES

explanation.walkthrough: Split 'setback' into SET plus 'back', which reverses it to TES; 'involving' then puts HAM inside.

parts.note: a well is a spring of water
and means also or too

explanation.surface: A river that is a spring as well.
explanation.definitionFit: An English waterway in the East Midlands flowing into the Wash.

clue.text: Like a hymn's mind" affecting lame dogs

indicators.note: affecting means acting upon and changing, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A hymn line about a cheerful mind having an effect on lame dogs.
explanation.walkthrough: The hymn is 'Let us with a gladsome mind'; the clue as held has lost the words before 'mind'.
explanation.definitionFit: The hymn opens Let us with a cheerful-hearted mind, using this word for joyful.

clue.text: Sea-bird eating knot on tropical plant

parts.note: a tern is a sea-bird
a reef is a kind of knot
